text_block_list.text:
A social gathering for Academy trainers, 
is it? I see.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"When constructing a meaningful training 
regimen, exchanging information between 
Trainers is indispensable. Naturally, your 
participation is requested."
